Mutable default argument list shared across calls, so line items accumulate between invoices
Broad except swallows every charge failure and returns None silently
Charge request has no idempotency key, so a retry can double-charge the customer

Leftover debug print of the invoice on the request path
File opened without an explicit encoding
Database write failure after a successful charge leaves orders unbilled
CSV export I/O failure after the charge is committed returns a 500 for a billed customer
Database connection is held open across a network call with up to a 10 second timeout
Only RequestException is caught, so a database or CSV error aborts the whole scheduled run
Stock cache is keyed by SKU only, so one tenant can receive another tenant's stock levels
Cancel updates any held reservation by id without checking tenant or owner
